overview_description.description:
Rosebud Biosciences is a biotech company that develops medicines for uncommon genetic illnesses in children. They collaborate with pharmaceutical firms to evaluate their products and conduct their own drug development for rare illnesses with no known therapies.

Rosebud Biosciences is headquartered in San Carlos, California and was founded in 2020.

about_short_description.short_description: Rosebud Biosciences is a biotech company that develops medicines for uncommon genetic illnesses in children.

product.name: Organoid Platform
product.description: A platform that models genetic diseases using micropatterned organoids derived from patient-specific human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) to replicate genetic mutations for drug screening.

product.name: Cardiac Organoids
product.description: Organoids that model heart tissue with patient-specific genetic mutations to study cardiac genetic diseases and screen potential therapies.

product.name: Hepatic Organoids
product.description: Organoids that replicate liver tissue with patient-specific genetic mutations for studying hepatic genetic diseases and evaluating treatments.

product.name: Neural Organoids
product.description: Organoids that model neural tissue with patient-specific genetic mutations to investigate neurological genetic diseases and test therapies.

product.name: Kidney Organoids (In Progress)
product.description: Developing organoids that model kidney tissue with patient-specific genetic mutations to study renal genetic diseases and support drug discovery.
